messages:
Jordan (Acme): Hey team — we've noticed that after yesterday's model bump our bot's replies have become terser and more formal. A lot of our end users are saying it feels 'short' and lost some of the helpful warmth. Anyone else seeing this?

lina_support: sorry to hear that, Jordan. can you paste an example prompt + reply before/after? helps a ton for triage.

Jordan (Acme): Sure — short customer question and two replies. BEFORE (v1.4):
```
Q: How do I reset my API key if it's expired?
A: You can reset it from Settings → API keys. Click "Rotate key" and paste the new key into your app. If you want, I can walk you through the steps or generate CLI commands.
```
AFTER (v1.5):
```
Q: How do I reset my API key if it's expired?
A: Go to Settings → API keys. Click "Rotate key".
```

Jordan (Acme): See how the old one offered extra help and a CLI option. now it's just the minimal step. feels less customer-friendly.

lina_support: thanks. adding logs and escalating. @omar_infra can you check whether the model variant or prompt-template changes rolled out yesterday?

omar_infra: deploybot shows a rollout at 2026-02-23 04:12 UTC: model rwd-llama-13b v1.5 -> promoted global. no config rewrite in rollout job; only backend model binary replaced.

deploybot: [deploy] 2026-02-23T04:12:01Z promoted rwd-llama-13b:v1.5 to prod-routes (canary 10% -> 100%)

omar_infra: quick hypothesis — the v1.5 checkpoint had a different decoding config (temperature/top_p) baked in at compile time by the model-onboarding step. i'll pull the exact serving-config now.

sree_qa: jordan — can you confirm whether you hit hosted api or dedicated? we need the route to replay the exact context (prefixes, system messages).

Jordan (Acme): Hosted API, route: /v1/chat/redwood/primary, they use our standard system prompt and have a short user message.

sree_qa: reproducing locally with the same system + example prompts. initial run: v1.4 gives verbose helpful answer; v1.5 returns shorter. capturing deltas.

sree_qa: snippet of reproduced outputs —
```
SYSTEM: You are Assistly, friendly support agent for Acme. Keep helpful tone and offer next steps.
USER: How do I reset my API key if it's expired?
--- v1.4 RESPONSE ---
You can reset it from Settings → API keys. Click "Rotate key" and paste the new key into your app. If you want, I can walk you through the steps or generate CLI commands.
--- v1.5 RESPONSE ---
Go to Settings → API keys. Click "Rotate key".
```

sree_qa: looks like v1.5 tends to truncate optional follow-ups and suggestions. i ran 50 samples, v1.5 omitted follow-up offers in ~72% of runs vs ~18% for v1.4.

lina_support: that's a big hit for our customer's UX. Jordan — apologies. we'll route this to product + runtime. @jen_product can you take?

jen_product: on it. couple of quick questions: (1) Is the behavior limited to specific persona/system prompts? (2) Any change in avg token counts or latency?

sree_qa: behavior consistent across several system prompts that emphasize friendly/helpful tone. avg response token count dropped from 62->39 for the sample set. latency roughly the same.

omar_infra: digging into compile-time flags now. v1.5 was compiled with a different biasing step to prefer concise outputs — we added a global length penalty during kernel selection to shave plateau tokens for some enterprise latency SLAs. that could cause this.

jen_product: thanks — that's probably the culprit. was that change gated? it should have been behind a policy flag. @omar_infra can you revert the length-penalty/serving override for the primary route and canary to test?

omar_infra: i can flip a serving-config override that removes the length-penalty for the route in ~15min. will do a fast canary.

deploybot: [config] 2026-02-23T05:02:10Z apply override: primary-route remove length_penalty=true -> now false (canary 10%).

lina_support: Jordan — we'll run a quick test and post sample outputs. thanks for the repro.

sree_qa: post-override outputs look restored:
```
USER: How do I reset my API key if it's expired?
RESPONSE (v1.5 + override): You can reset it from Settings → API keys. Click "Rotate key" and paste the new key into your app. If you'd like, I can also provide CLI commands or walk you through it.
```

Jordan (Acme): That's waaaay better. thanks! any ETA on full rollout fix?

jen_product: we'll keep the override while we validate across workloads. plan is a targeted recompile without the global length penalty and run perf tests — aim to have a stable build in 48 hours.

omar_infra: noting follow-ups: (1) add automated regression tests that check for helpful/ask-to-continue sentences in support-style system prompts, (2) move length_penalty to a tunable feature-flag per-route, not baked in model binary.

lina_support: documenting the incident and next steps for Jordan. Jordan — i'll follow up with weekly status until fixed. apologies again. :handshake:

Jordan (Acme): Appreciate the quick attention. That'll do for now.

lina_support: closing the support escal. creating a ticket for eng/runtime and product with the sample traces and perf checks. :thumbsup:
